muyesser-irab:100-100.t:
﴿ورفع أبويه على العرش وخروا له سجدا﴾: the واو is a conjunction; رفع أبويه is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على العرش﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رفع﴾; ﴿خروا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خروا﴾; سجدًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وقال يا أبت هذا تأويل رؤياي من قبل﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أبت﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the omitted ياء of the first person; ﴿هذا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and تأويل the khabar (predicate); رؤياي is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿قد جعلها ربي حقا﴾: قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); جعلها ربي is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil; حقًّا is the second object; the clause is a ḥāl, either anticipated (muqaddara) or concurrent (muqārina).
﴿وقد أحسن بي إذ أخرجني من السجن﴾: the واو is a conjunction; قد is a particle of verification; أحسن is a past verb; ﴿بي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحسن﴾; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) also attached to ﴿أحسن﴾; the clause أخرجني is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the fāʿil is latent, and the ياء is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿من السجن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أخرجني﴾.
﴿وجاء بكم من البدو من بعد أن نزغ الشيطان بيني وبين إخوتي﴾: ﴿بكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جاء﴾; ﴿من البدو﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun also attached to it; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; أن together with what falls in its scope is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; الشيطان is the fāʿil of نزغ; ﴿بيني﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿نزغ﴾; ﴿بين﴾ is conjoined to the first adverb and annexed to ﴿إخوتي﴾.
﴿إن ربي لطيف لما يشاء﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ربي is its noun and لطيف its khabar; ﴿لما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿لطيف﴾; the clause يشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه هو العليم الحكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and the هاء is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and العليم الحكيم are two khabars of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and العليم الحكيم are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:101-101.t:
﴿رب قد آتيتني من الملك وعلمتني من تأويل الأحاديث﴾: رب is the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), annexed to the omitted ياء of the first person, and the vocative particle is omitted; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿آتيتني﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من الملك﴾: من is partitive (tabʿīḍiyya), and it together with its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl bihi, i.e. "you have given me something great of the kingdom"; it is also said to be explicative (tabyīniyya), in which case it is attached to ﴿آتيتني﴾; علمتني is conjoined to آتيتني; ﴿من تأويل الأحاديث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿علمتني﴾.
﴿فاطر السماوات والأرض﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب﴾, or a badal (substitute) from it, or one addressed in the vocative with the vocative particle omitted; السماوات is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أنت وليي في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿وليي﴾ the khabar (predicate); ﴿في الدنيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وليي﴾; الآخرة is conjoined to الدنيا.
﴿توفني مسلما وألحقني بالصالحين﴾: a verb of supplication; the نون is the nūn of protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the ياء is the mafʿūl bihi; مسلمًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ألحقني is conjoined to توفني; ﴿بالصالحين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألحقني﴾.

muyesser-irab:102-102.t:
﴿ذلك من أنباء الغيب نوحيه إليك﴾: ذلك is a demonstrative in the position of nominative (rafʿ) as the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من أنباء الغيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); the clause نوحيه إليك is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a second khabar.
﴿وما كنت لديهم إذ أجمعوا أمرهم وهم يمكرون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿كنت﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and the تاء is its noun; ﴿لديهم﴾ is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the omitted khabar of كنت; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of time attached to the omitted khabar to which ﴿لديهم﴾ is attached; the clause أجمعوا is in the position of genitive through the annexation of the adverb to it; the واو is for the ḥāl; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ and the clause يمكرون is the khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl clause.

muyesser-irab:103-103.t: ﴿وما أكثر الناس ولو حرصت بمؤمنين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿أكثر﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿الناس﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿ولو﴾: the واو is parenthetical, and ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿حرصت﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the answer of ﴿لو﴾ is omitted, indicated by what precedes, i.e. "even if you were eager for the faith of most people, they are not believers"; the clause ﴿ولو حرصت﴾ is parenthetical between the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾ and its khabar (predicate), with no grammatical position; ﴿بمؤمنين﴾: the باء is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and ﴿مؤمنين﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) by position and genitive (majrūr) in form by the باء.

muyesser-irab:104-104.t:
﴿وما تسألهم عليه من أجر﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is negative; تسألهم is an imperfect verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and the pronoun refers to the Qurʾān; ﴿من﴾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition, and أجر is genitive in form by من, accusative by position as a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين﴾: إن is negative; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ذكر is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هو﴾; ﴿للعالمين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ذكر﴾.

muyesser-irab:105-105.t:
﴿وكأين من آية في السماوات والأرض﴾: كأين is in the position of nominative (rafʿ) as the mubtadaʾ (subject); من is a connective (ṣila) particle, and آية is genitive in form by ﴿من﴾, accusative by position as the tamyīz (specification) of ﴿كأين﴾; ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿آية﴾.
﴿يمرون عليها وهم عنها معرضون﴾: the clause يمرون is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; ﴿عنها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿معرضون﴾; معرضون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾, and the nominal clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause. Or ﴿في السماوات والأرض﴾ is the khabar of ﴿كأين﴾, and the clause يمرون is an adjective of ﴿آية﴾.

muyesser-irab:106-106.t: ﴿وما يؤمن أكثرهم بالله إلا وهم مشركون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ما is negative; يؤمن أكثرهم is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمن﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the واو is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and مشركون the khabar (predicate), and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:107-107.t:
﴿أفأمنوا أن تأتيهم غاشية من عذاب الله﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and it carries the sense of rebuke and threat; the فاء is a conjunction; أمنوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) formed from ﴿أن تأتيهم﴾ is the object of أمنوا; the هاء is the object of تأتي, and غاشية is the fāʿil of تأتي; ﴿من عذاب الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿غاشية﴾.
﴿أو تأتيهم الساعة بغتة وهم لا يشعرون﴾: ﴿أو تأتيهم﴾ is conjoined to the preceding تأتيهم; الساعة is the fāʿil of تأتيهم; بغتة is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the واو is for the ḥāl; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the clause لا يشعرون the khabar (predicate), and the clause is accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:108-108.t:
﴿قل هذه سبيلي أدعو إلى الله على بصيرة أنا ومن اتبعني﴾: قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). هذه: the mubtadaʾ (subject). سبيلي: the khabar (predicate), and the ياء is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. أدعو: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدعو﴾. The clause ﴿أدعو إلى الله﴾ is explicative of "the way", or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿سبيلي﴾. ﴿على بصيرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أدعو﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil of أدعو; ﴿أنا﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil of أدعو, and ومن اتبعني is conjoined to the latent fāʿil of أدعو; or ﴿مَن﴾ is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "and whoever follows me also calls"; or ﴿أنا﴾ is a delayed mubtadaʾ, ﴿على بصيرة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted, advanced khabar, and ومن اتبعني is conjoined to ﴿أنا﴾.
﴿وسبحان الله وما أنا من المشركين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; سبحان: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative by an omitted verb; the Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وما﴾: the واو is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negative particle, operating like ليس; ﴿أنا﴾ is the noun of ما, and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of ما. Or ﴿ما﴾ is a non-operative negative particle, ﴿أنا﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, and ﴿من المشركين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:109-109.t:
﴿وما أرسلنا من قبلك إلا رجالا نوحي إليهم من أهل القرى﴾: ما is negative; أرسلنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من قبلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); رجالًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause نوحي إليهم is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿من أهل القرى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second adjective of ﴿رجالًا﴾.
﴿أفلم يسيروا في الأرض﴾: the hamza is interrogative; the فاء conjoins to something omitted; لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; يسيروا is an imperfect verb made jussive by ﴿لم﴾; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يسيروا﴾.
﴿فينظروا كيف كان عاقبة الذين من قبلهم﴾: the فاء is a conjunction, or causal (sababiyya); ينظروا is an imperfect verb, jussive by conjunction to يسيروا, or accusative by an implied أن in answer to the negation, and the interpreted maṣdar (maṣdar muʾawwal) from أن and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, its implied form being: "Was there not a travelling, and then a looking?"; كيف is an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as the advanced khabar (predicate) of كان; عاقبة is the noun of كان, and الذين is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿من قبلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولدار الآخرة خير للذين اتقوا﴾: the واو is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); دار is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الآخرة is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar of دار; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿خير﴾; the clause ﴿اتقوا﴾ is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أفلا تعقلون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and wonder (istifhām inkārī taʿajjubī), and it enters upon something implied which is what this conjunction conjoins to; the interrogative clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:110-110.t:
﴿حتى إذا استيأس الرسل وظنوا أنهم قد كذبوا﴾: حتى is a particle of limit (ghāya); ﴿ظنوا﴾ is conjoined to استيأسوا [Translator's note: the Quranic text reads ﴿استيأس الرسل﴾; the source writes it here as استيأسوا]; أن together with what falls in its scope takes the place of the two objects of ظنوا; كذبوا is in the passive (built on the form whose agent is not named), i.e. the nations thought that the messengers had broken the promise of victory they had been given; the clause كذبوا is the khabar (predicate) of أنهم.
﴿جاءهم نصرنا فنجي من نشاء﴾: the clause جاءهم is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the answer of إذا; جاءهم نصرنا is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); the فاء is a conjunction; نجي is in the passive, conjoined to جاءهم; ﴿مَن﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); نشاء is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يرد بأسنا عن القوم المجرمين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; لا is negative; يرد is in the passive; بأسنا is the nāʾib fāʿil; ﴿عن القوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرد﴾; المجرمين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:111-111.t:
﴿لقد كان في قصصهم عبرة لأولي الألباب﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿في قصصهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted, advanced khabar (predicate) of كان; عبرة is the delayed noun of كان; ﴿لأولي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عبرة﴾, and الألباب is the muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ما كان حديثا يفترى﴾: ما is negative; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to the Qurʾān; حديثًا is its khabar; the clause يفترى is an adjective of ﴿حديثًا﴾.
﴿ولكن تصديق الذي بين يديه وتفصيل كل شيء وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون﴾: the واو is a conjunction; لكن is lightened and inoperative; تصديق is conjoined to ﴿حديثًا﴾, or on the assumption of an implied "كان"; ﴿الذي﴾ is the muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb that is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; ﴿وتفصيل كل شيء وهدى ورحمة﴾ are conjoined to ﴿تصديق﴾; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿رحمة﴾; the clause يؤمنون is an adjective of قوم.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿قال هل علمتم ما فعلتم بيوسف وأخيه إذ أنتم جاهلون﴾: هل is an interrogative particle; علمتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or it is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), i.e. "your doing to Yūsuf"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فعلتم﴾; ﴿أخيه﴾ is conjoined to يوسف; إذ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿فعلتم﴾, i.e. "you did at the time of your ignorance"; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and جاهلون the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is the muḍāf ilayhi to which the adverb is annexed.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t:
﴿قالوا أئنك لأنت يوسف﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿أإنك﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the كاف is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); أنت is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and يوسف the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of إن; or ﴿أنت﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) and يوسف is the khabar of إن.
﴿قال أنا يوسف وهذا أخي قد من الله علينا﴾: أنا is the mubtadaʾ and يوسف the khabar; هذا is a mubtadaʾ and أخي the khabar; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); ﴿منَّ﴾ is a past verb, ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil, and ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿منَّ﴾; the clause ﴿قد مَنّ الله علينا﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; it is also said to be a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.
﴿إنه من يتق ويصبر فإن الله لا يضيع أجر المحسنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle and the هاء is its noun; ﴿مَن﴾ is a conditional noun that makes the verb jussive, in the position of nominative (rafʿ) as a mubtadaʾ; ﴿يتق﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; يصبر is conjoined to it; ﴿فإن الله﴾: the فاء links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, the clause لا يضيع is its khabar, and أجر المحسنين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the conditional clause together with its apodosis is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿قالوا تالله لقد آثرك الله علينا﴾: the تاء is the تاء of oath, and the Name of Majesty is genitive by it; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "نقسم" (we swear); the lām is the answer to the oath; قد is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); آثرك الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آثرك﴾.
﴿وإن كنا لخاطئين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿إن﴾ is lightened from the heavy (إنّ), inoperative, having no governing effect; كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the lām of distinction (al-lām al-fāriqa); خاطئين is the khabar (predicate) of كنا.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿قال لا تثريب عليكم اليوم﴾: the clause ﴿لا تثريب﴾ is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl); لا is the lā of generic negation, تثريب is its noun, and ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); اليوم is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted second khabar, or to what the khabar is attached to, namely ﴿عليكم﴾; or the adverb is attached to the verb that comes after it.
﴿يغفر الله لكم وهو أرحم الراحمين﴾: a clause of supplication functioning as a statement of reason; يغفر الله is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يغفر﴾; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أرحم الراحمين the khabar.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t:
﴿اذهبوا بقميصي هذا فألقوه على وجه أبي يأت بصيرا﴾: اذهبوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿بقميصي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اذهبوا﴾, the باء being for making the verb transitive (taʿdiya); or the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "go, having my shirt with you"; ﴿هذا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective), or a badal (substitute), or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); ﴿فألقوه﴾: the فاء is a conjunction, and ألقوه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على وجه أبي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألقوه﴾; يأت is a jussive imperfect verb, because it is the answer to the imperative, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿بصيرًا﴾ is a ḥāl, or it is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿يأت﴾ on the basis that it implicitly carries the meaning "يصير بصيرًا" (he will become seeing).
﴿وأتوني بأهلكم أجمعين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ائتوني is conjoined to ﴿اذهبوا﴾; ﴿بأهلكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ائتوني﴾; أجمعين is a tawkīd (emphasis) of الأهل.

muyesser-irab:94-94.t: ﴿ولما فصلت العير قال أبوهم إني لأجد ريح يوسف لولا أن تفندون﴾: لما is adverbial (ẓarfiyya) or a linking particle (rābiṭa); فصلت العير is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the ياء is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause ﴿أجد﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and ريح يوسف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لولا is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd); أن together with what falls in its scope is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being "لولا تفنيدكم موجود" (were it not that your charge of senility exists); the answer of لولا is omitted, i.e. "لصدقتموني" (you would have believed me).

muyesser-irab:95-95.t: ﴿قالوا تالله إنك لفي ضلالك القديم﴾: the تاء is the تاء of oath; ﴿الله﴾ is genitive by the تاء of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb of the oath; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the كاف is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في ضلالك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; ﴿القديم﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:96-96.t:
﴿فلما أن جاء البشير ألقاه على وجهه فارتد بصيرا﴾: لما is adverbial, temporal (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking particle (rābiṭa); أن is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant); ﴿جاء البشير﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ألقاه is a clause with no grammatical position, and the هاء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على وجهه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألقاه﴾; ﴿فارتد﴾: the فاء is a conjunction, and ارتد is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "هو"; ﴿بصيرًا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿ارتد﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb operating like ﴿صار﴾, and بصيرًا is its khabar (predicate).
﴿قال ألم أقل لكم إني أعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (istifhām taqrīrī); لم is a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; ﴿أقل﴾ is an imperfect verb made jussive by ﴿لم﴾, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنا"; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أقل﴾; إن is an abrogating particle, the ياء is its noun, and the clause أعلم is its khabar; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause لا تعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:97-97.t: ﴿قالوا يا أبانا استغفر لنا ذنوبنا إنا كنا خاطئين﴾: يا أبانا is the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), a muḍāf (annexed noun); استغفر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استغفر﴾; ذنوبنا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنا خاطئين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of إن; كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and خاطئين is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:98-98.t:
﴿قال سوف أستغفر لكم ربي﴾: the clause سوف أستغفر is the speech reported by the verb "said" (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أستغفر﴾; ﴿ربي﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنه هو الغفور الرحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the هاء is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and الغفور الرحيم are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿هو﴾, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إن; or ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and الغفور الرحيم are two khabars of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:99-99.t:
﴿فلما دخلوا على يوسف آوى إليه أبويه﴾: conjoined to something omitted; دخلوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دخلوا﴾; the clause ﴿آوى﴾ is a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿آوى﴾; أبويه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وقال ادخلوا مصر إن شاء الله آمنين﴾: the واو is a conjunction; ﴿ادخلوا مصر﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional, شاء is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because the context indicates it; the conditional clause ﴿إن شاء الله﴾ is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) and the one it describes (ṣāḥib al-ḥāl), with no grammatical position; ﴿آمنين﴾ is a ḥāl from the واو in ﴿ادخلوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿الر﴾: the discussion of the disjointed letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has already been given at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.
﴿تلك آيات الكتاب المبين﴾: تلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); آيات is the khabar (predicate); الكتاب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and المبين is an adjective (ṣifa) of الكتاب.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿إنا أنزلناه قرآنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause أنزلناه is its khabar (predicate); قرآنًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun of أنزلناه, i.e. the hā', or it is accusative as a badal (substitute) of the pronoun; عربيًّا is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿لعلكم تعقلون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle, the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿تعقلون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿نحن نقص عليك أحسن القصص بما أوحينا إليك هذا القرآن﴾: نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause نقص is the khabar (predicate), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نقص﴾; ﴿أحسن﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); القصص is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the bā' is causal; ما is maṣdariyya; ﴿ما﴾ together with what falls within its scope is genitive by the bā', and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿نقص﴾, i.e. "by means of Our revealing"; ﴿إليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾; ﴿هذا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and القرآن is a badal (substitute) of the demonstrative.
﴿وإن كنت من قبله لمن الغافلين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إن is lightened from the heavy (inna); its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); كنت is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the tā' is its noun; ﴿من قبله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is the differentiating lām (al-fāriqa); ﴿من الغافلين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of كنت. The clause ﴿كنت من قبله ...﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿إذ قال يوسف لأبيه يا أبت﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال يا بني﴾ in the following ayah, the implied form being: "Jacob said: O my son, do not relate your dream to your brothers, at the time when Joseph said such-and-such to him"; or it is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); or it is in the position of the accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of ﴿أحسن القصص﴾, if we parse ﴿أحسن القصص﴾ as a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿قال يوسف﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿لأبيه﴾ is attached to ﴿قال﴾; يا is a vocative particle; and أبت is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yā' of the first person, which has been dropped and replaced with the tā' bearing kasra.
﴿إني رأيت أحد عشر كوكبا﴾: the yā' is the noun of إن; the clause رأيت is its khabar (predicate); أحد عشر are two numeral parts, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿رأيت﴾; and كوكبًا is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿والشمس والقمر رأيتهم لي ساجدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; الشمس and القمر are conjoined to ﴿أحد عشر كوكبًا﴾; رأيتهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ساجدين﴾; and ساجدين is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of رأيت.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿قال يا بني لا تقصص رؤياك على إخوتك﴾: يا is a vocative particle; بني is the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the yā' of the first person; لا is prohibitive; تقصص is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; رؤياك is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿على إخوتك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقصص﴾.
﴿فيكيدوا لك كيدا﴾: the fā' is causal (sababiyya); يكيدوا is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding words, i.e. "let there be no relating, and then a plotting". The wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يكيدوا﴾; ﴿كيدًا﴾ is an emphatic mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and it has been said that it is a mafʿūl bihi, the implied form being: "they would contrive a plot against you".
﴿إن الشيطان للإنسان عدو مبين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الشيطان is its noun; ﴿للإنسان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); عدو is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and مبين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وكذلك يجتبيك ربك ويعلمك من تأويل الأحاديث﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a choosing like that choosing your Lord will choose you"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿يجتبيك﴾ is an imperfect verb and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ربك is the fāʿil (agent); يعلمك is resumptive speech with no grammatical position, as though it were said: "and He will teach you and complete His favour"; ﴿من تأويل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يعلمك﴾; and الأحاديث is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿ويتم نعمته عليك وعلى آل يعقوب﴾: it is conjoined to يعلمك; نعمته is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿عليك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعمته﴾ or to ﴿يتم﴾; and ﴿على آل يعقوب﴾ is conjoined to it.
﴿كما أتمها على أبويك من قبل إبراهيم وإسحاق﴾: ﴿كما أتمها﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "He will complete His favour upon you and upon the family of Jacob with a completing like His completing it upon your two fathers"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿أتمها﴾ is a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أتمها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿على أبويك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أتمها﴾; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿إبراهيم﴾ is a badal (substitute) of ﴿أبويك﴾ or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); and إسحاق is conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿إن ربك عليم حكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ربك is its noun; and عليم حكيم are its two khabars (predicates).

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿لقد كان في يوسف وإخوته آيات للسائلين﴾: the lām is the response to an omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿في يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿إخوته﴾ is conjoined to يوسف; آيات is the noun of كان placed after; and ﴿للسائلين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿آيات﴾.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿إذ قالوا ليوسف وأخوه أحب إلى أبينا منا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb of past time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كان﴾ in the previous ayah; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); ﴿أخوه﴾ is conjoined to يوسف; ﴿أحب﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿إلى أبينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحب﴾; and ﴿منا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحب﴾.
﴿ونحن عصبة إن أبانا لفي ضلال مبين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿عصبة﴾ the khabar; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and أبانا is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿في ضلال﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar; and مبين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿اقتلوا يوسف أو اطرحوه أرضا يخل لكم وجه أبيكم﴾: اقتلوا is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and يوسف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أو اطرحوه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿اقتلوا﴾; أرضًا is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in a land"; ﴿يخل﴾ is the response to the command; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخل﴾; ﴿وجه﴾ is the fāʿil; and أبيكم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وتكونوا من بعده قوما صالحين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; تكونوا is conjoined to ﴿يخل﴾; the wāw is the noun of كان; ﴿من بعده﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); قومًا is the khabar (predicate); and صالحين is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿قال قائل منهم لا تقتلوا يوسف وألقوه في غيابت الجب﴾: ﴿قال قائل﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿منهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa); لا is prohibitive; ﴿تقتلوا﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; يوسف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ألقوه is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿في غيابة الجب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ألقوه﴾.
﴿يلتقطه بعض السيارة إن كنتم فاعلين﴾: يلتقطه is the response to the command, jussive, and the pronoun is in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi; بعض السيارة is the fāʿil; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tā' is its noun, and فاعلين its khabar (predicate); and the apodosis (jawāb) of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿قالوا يا أبانا ما لك لا تأمنا على يوسف﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿يا أبانا﴾ is an annexed munādā (the one addressed); ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿ما﴾; لا is negating; تأمنا is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and نا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿على يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تأمنا﴾; the clause لا تأمنا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يا أبانا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the clause ﴿لا تأمنا﴾ is a ḥāl of the pronoun in ﴿لك﴾.
﴿وإنا له لناصحون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ناصحون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ناصحون is the khabar of ﴿إنا﴾; and the clause is a ḥāl of ﴿نا﴾ in ﴿تأمنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿أرسله معنا غدا يرتع ويلعب وإنا له لحافظون﴾: أرسله is an imperative verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿معنا﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسله﴾, and ﴿نا﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿غدًا﴾ is an adverb also attached to ﴿أرسله﴾; يرتع is jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command, and يلعب is conjoined to it; ﴿إنا له لحافظون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿حافظون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿حافظون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إنا﴾; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿نا﴾ in ﴿معنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿قال إني ليحزنني أن تذهبوا به﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the yā' is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause يحزنني is the khabar (predicate) of إن, and the yā' is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أن together with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يحزنني﴾; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذهبوا﴾.
﴿وأخاف أن يأكله الذئب﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is the object of ﴿أخاف﴾, and الذئب is the fāʿil of ﴿يأكله﴾.
﴿وأنتم عنه غافلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and غافلون its khabar; and ﴿عنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿غافلون﴾.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿قالوا لئن أكله الذئب ونحن عصبة إنا إذا لخاسرون﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; أكله الذئب is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), نحن is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and عصبة the khabar (predicate), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾ is an inoperative particle of response and requital; ﴿خاسرون﴾ is the khabar of إن; the clause is the response to the oath; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) clause is omitted.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فلما ذهبوا به وأجمعوا أن يجعلوه في غيابت الجب﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); ذهبوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذهبوا﴾; أجمعوا is conjoined to ذهبوا, or the wāw is circumstantial and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) with قد implied; أن together with what falls within its scope is the object of ﴿أجمعوا﴾, or accusative by removal of the preposition; ﴿في غيابة الجب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يجعلوه﴾; and the response of لما is omitted, its implied form being: "they did to him the harm that they did".
﴿وأوحينا إليه لتنبئنهم بأمرهم هذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوحينا﴾; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; تنبئنهم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and the hā' is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بأمرهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تنبئنهم﴾; and ﴿هذا﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أمرهم﴾.
﴿وهم لا يشعرون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause لا يشعرون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t: ﴿وجاءوا أباهم عشاء يبكون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جاءوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أباهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عشاء is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاء﴾; and the clause ﴿يبكون﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿قالوا يا أبانا إنا ذهبنا نستبق﴾: the clause ﴿إنا ذهبنا﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ذهبنا is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause نستبق is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وتركنا يوسف عند متاعنا فأكله الذئب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; تركنا يوسف is conjoined to ﴿ذهبنا﴾; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾; فأكله is conjoined; the hā' is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and الذئب is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وما أنت بمؤمن لنا ولو كنا صادقين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿أنت﴾ is the noun of mā; ﴿بمؤمن﴾: the bā' is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿مؤمن﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative (manṣūb) in position and genitive (majrūr) in form because of the bā'; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿مؤمن﴾; ﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and لو is conditional; ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and صادقين its khabar.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿وجاءوا على قميصه بدم كذب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جاؤوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿على قميصه﴾ is in the position of the accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), as though it were said: "and they came, upon his shirt, with blood"; this adverb is governed by an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of دم, the implied form being: "and they came with false blood while it was upon his shirt"; ﴿بدم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءوا﴾; and كذب is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿قال بل سولت لكم أنفسكم أمرا فصبر جميل﴾: بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); ﴿سولت لكم أنفسكم﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; أمرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿فصبر جميل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted.
﴿والله المستعان على ما تصفون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and ﴿المستعان﴾ the khabar; ﴿على ما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿المستعان﴾; the clause تصفون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. تصفونه.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿وجاءت سيارة فأرسلوا واردهم فأدلى دلوه﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; جاءت سيارة is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); فأرسلوا is conjoined to جاءت, and the wāw is the fāʿil; واردهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فأدلى is conjoined; and دلوه is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قال يا بشرى هذا غلام﴾: يا is a vocative particle; بشرى is a munādā (the one addressed) that is an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda); ﴿هذا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and ﴿غلام﴾ the khabar (predicate).
﴿وأسروه بضاعة﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; أسروه is a verb, its fāʿil and its object. [Translator's note: the source does not parse بضاعة.]
﴿والله عليم بما يعملون﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and عليم the khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عليم﴾, and ما is maṣdariyya; the clause ﴿يعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿وشروه بثمن بخس دراهم معدودة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; شروه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object; ﴿بثمن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿شروه﴾; بخس is an adjective (ṣifa); دراهم is a badal (substitute) of ثمن; and معدودة is an adjective.
﴿وكانوا فيه من الزاهدين﴾: كانوا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿من الزاهدين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿وقال الذي اشتراه من مصر لامرأته أكرمي مثواه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; قال is a past verb; ﴿الذي﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause اشتراه is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿من مصر﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿لامرأته﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause أكرمي مثواه is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), and it is a verb, its fāʿil and its object.
﴿عسى أن ينفعنا أو نتخذه ولدا﴾: عسى is one of the verbs of hope (rajāʾ); its noun is latent (mustatir); أن together with what falls within its scope is its khabar (predicate); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; نتخذ is an imperfect verb conjoined to ﴿ينفعنا﴾; the hā' is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ولدًا the second.
﴿وكذلك مكنا ليوسف في الأرض﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "and with an establishing like that establishing We established"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; مكنا is a past verb and its fāʿil; ﴿ليوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; and ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولنعلمه من تأويل الأحاديث﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is causal (taʿlīl); نعلمه is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, and the hā' is the mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿مكنا﴾; and ﴿من تأويل الأحاديث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نعلمه﴾.
﴿والله غالب على أمره﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and غالب the khabar; ﴿على أمره﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿غالب﴾; and the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿أكثر الناس﴾ is its noun; and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿ولما بلغ أشده آتيناه حكما وعلما وكذلك نجزي المحسنين﴾: لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); بلغ أشده is a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آتيناه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; حكمًا is a second mafʿūl bihi, and علمًا is conjoined to it; ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "and with a recompense like that We recompense the doers of good"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "We" (نحن); and ﴿المحسنين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿وراودته التي هو في بيتها عن نفسه وغلقت الأبواب وقالت هيت لك﴾: conjoined clauses; ﴿وراودته التي﴾ is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿هو في بيتها﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿عن نفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راودته﴾; غلقت الأبواب is conjoined to راودته, and قالت is also conjoined; ﴿هيت﴾ is a verbal noun of the past (ism fiʿl māḍin), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, meaning "I have made myself ready", or a verbal noun of the imperative (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "come", its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿لك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted, i.e. "I say".
﴿قال معاذ الله إنه ربي أحسن مثواي﴾: معاذ الله is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "I seek refuge in Allah, a seeking of refuge"; ﴿إنه﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hā' is its noun, and ربي is its khabar (predicate).
﴿إنه لا يفلح الظالمون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the hā' is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يفلح الظالمون﴾ is its khabar; the pronoun here refers to the matter (al-shaʾn).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿ولقد همت به وهم بها لولا أن رأى برهان ربه﴾: the lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); همت is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "she" (هي); ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿همت﴾; همّ is a past verb, and its fāʿil is "he" (هو); ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿همّ﴾; لولا is the particle of "non-occurrence due to occurrence"; أن together with what falls within its scope is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "were it not for his seeing the proof of his Lord standing before him"; and the response of لولا is omitted, i.e. "he would have lain with her".
﴿كذلك لنصرف عنه السوء والفحشاء﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "We made him firm with a making-firm like that making-firm", or "We showed him the proof of his Lord with a showing like that showing, that We might turn evil away from him"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. ﴿لنصرف﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl); نصرف is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "We" (نحن); the interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām with its genitive is attached to the implied ﴿ثبتناه﴾ or ﴿أريناه﴾; ﴿السوء﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿الفحشاء﴾ is conjoined to السوء.
﴿إنه من عبادنا المخلصين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; ﴿من عبادنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar; and المخلصين is an adjective of ﴿عبادنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿واستبقا الباب وقدت قميصه من دبر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿استبقا﴾ is a past verb, and the alif is the fāʿil (agent); الباب is accusative by removal of the preposition; ﴿قدّت قميصه﴾: قدّ is a past verb, its fāʿil being "she" (هي), and قميصه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿من دبر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿قدت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿واستبقا﴾, or it is a ḥāl, i.e. "having already torn".
﴿وألفيا سيدها لدا الباب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ألفيا is conjoined to what precedes, and the alif is the fāʿil; سيدها is the mafʿūl bihi; and لدى is an adverb (ẓarf) in the position of the accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿قالت ما جزاء من أراد بأهلك سوءا إلا أن يسجن أو عذاب أليم﴾: ما is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); جزاء is the khabar (predicate); ﴿مَن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause أراد is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿بأهلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أراد﴾; سوءًا is the mafʿūl bihi; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and what falls within its scope is a badal (substitute) of جزاء, i.e. "except imprisonment"; or ﴿ما﴾ is negating, جزاء is the mubtadaʾ, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يسجن﴾ is its khabar; ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; عذاب is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar; and أليم is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun and the clause ﴿أراد﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; or it is an indefinite described noun (nakira mawṣūfa) and the clause ﴿أراد﴾ is an adjective of ﴿مَن﴾.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قال هي راودتني عن نفسي﴾: ﴿قال﴾ is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿هي﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause راودتني is the khabar (predicate); and عن نفسي is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿راودتني﴾.
﴿وشهد شاهد من أهلها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; شهد شاهد is a verb and its fāʿil; and ﴿من أهلها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿شاهد﴾.
﴿إن كان قميصه قد من قبل فصدقت وهو من الكاذبين﴾: the conditional sentence is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. "and he said"; إن is conditional; ﴿كان قميصه﴾: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), قميصه is its noun, and the clause ﴿قدّ﴾ is the khabar; ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قدّ﴾; ﴿فصدقت﴾: the fā' is linking (rābiṭa), صدقت is a past verb, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "then her truthfulness has become apparent"; ﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and ﴿من الكاذبين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿وإن كان قميصه قد من دبر فكذبت وهو من الصادقين﴾: conjoined to the first clause; the conditional sentence is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. "and he said"; إن is conditional; ﴿كان قميصه﴾: كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), قميصه is its noun, and the clause ﴿قدّ﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿من دبر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قدّ﴾; ﴿فكذبت﴾: the fā' is linking (rābiṭa), كذبت is a past verb, and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e. "then her lying has become apparent"; ﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فلما رأى قميصه قد من دبر قال إنه من كيدكن﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); رأى قميصه is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and an object; the clause ﴿قد من دبر﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿قال﴾ is the response of لما; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; and ﴿من كيدكن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿إن كيدكن عظيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; كيدكن is its noun; and عظيم is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿يوسف أعرض عن هذا واستغفري لذنبك﴾: يوسف is a munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; أعرض is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿عن هذا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعرض﴾; استغفري is an imperative verb, and the yā' is its fāʿil; and ﴿لذنبك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استغفري﴾.
﴿إنك كنت من الخاطئين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; كنت is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the tā' is its noun; ﴿من الخاطئين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿كنت﴾ is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وقال نسوة في المدينة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال نسوة﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿في المدينة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نسوة﴾.
﴿امرأت العزيز تراود فتاها عن نفسه قد شغفها حبا إنا لنراها في ضلال مبين﴾: امرأة العزيز is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause تراود is the khabar (predicate); فتاها is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿عن نفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تراود﴾; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); شغفها is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; حبًّا is a tamyīz (specification) transferred from the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿قد شغفها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of تراود, or of its object, or a second khabar of ﴿امرأة﴾. [Translator's note: the source does not parse إنا لنراها في ضلال مبين.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿فلما سمعت بمكرهن أرسلت إليهن وأعتدت لهن متكأ وآتت كل واحدة منهن سكينا﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); سمعت is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); ﴿بمكرهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سمعت﴾; the clause أرسلت has no grammatical position; ﴿إليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرسلت﴾; أعتدت is conjoined to أرسلت; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعتدت﴾; متكأ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آتت is also conjoined; ﴿كل واحدة﴾ is the first object of ﴿آتت﴾; ﴿منهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of واحدة; and سكينًا is the second object of آتت.
﴿وقالت اخرج عليهن﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the clause اخرج is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "looking down upon them".
﴿فلما رأينه أكبرنه وقطعن أيديهن﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; لما is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or a linking particle; رأينه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; قطعن is a verb and its fāʿil; and أيديهن is the mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source does not parse أكبرنه.]
﴿وقلن﴾: a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿حاش﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "declaring Allah far above [all imperfection]".
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted, its implied form being "I mean" (أعني).
﴿ما هذا بشرا﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿هذا﴾ is the noun of mā; and ﴿بشرًا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of mā.
﴿إن هذا إلا ملك كريم﴾: إن is negating; ﴿هذا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ملك is the khabar; and كريم is an adjective.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿قالت فذلكن الذي لمتنني فيه﴾: ﴿فذلك﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الذي is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "he is the one who"; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لمتنني﴾, i.e. "concerning loving him" or "seducing him"; and the clause ﴿لمتنني﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولقد راودته عن نفسه فاستعصم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is the response to the omitted oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); راودته is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عن نفسه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿راودته﴾; ﴿فاستعصم﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, and استعصم is a past verb.
﴿ولئن لم يفعل ما آمره ليسجنن وليكونا من الصاغرين﴾: the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, shifting (to the past) and the jussive; ﴿يفعل﴾ is a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun, the mafʿūl bihi; the clause آمره is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; the pronoun in ﴿آمره﴾ refers back to the relative noun, i.e. "what I command him to do", the preposition having been dropped just as it is dropped in أمرتك الخير ("I commanded you [to do] good"); the first object of ﴿آمر﴾ is omitted, and the implied form was: ما آمره به; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya, i.e. "my command", and the pronoun refers to Joseph, i.e. "my commanding him", its meaning being: "what my command requires"; the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the stated response to the oath, the implied form being: ليسجنن وليكونن; in ﴿يسجنن﴾ there is the heavy nūn of emphasis, and in ﴿يكونن﴾ the light nūn of emphasis; the noun of يكون is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and ﴿من الصاغرين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿قال رب السجن أحب إلي مما يدعونني إليه﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position; رب is a munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; السجن is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿أحب﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿إليّ﴾, for clarification (tabyīn), is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحب﴾; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أحب﴾; the clause يدعونني is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; it is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn on the wāw, the first nūn being the nūn of the feminine plural and the second the nūn of protection (wiqāya); and ﴿إليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يدعونني﴾.
﴿وإلا تصرف عني كيدهن أصب إليهن وأكن من الجاهلين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is conditional; لا is negating; تصرف is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿عني﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تصرف﴾; ﴿كيدهن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿أصب﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); ﴿إليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أصب﴾; ﴿أكن﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أصب﴾, the noun of ﴿أكن﴾ being latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); and ﴿من الجاهلين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of ﴿أكن﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿فاستجاب له ربه فصرف عنه كيدهن﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; استجاب is a past verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; ربه is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿فصرف﴾ is conjoined to ﴿فاستجاب﴾; ﴿عنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿صرف﴾; and كيدهن is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and السميع العليم are two khabars (predicates) of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a second mubtadaʾ (subject), السميع العليم are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of ﴿إن﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿ثم بدا لهم من بعد ما رأوا الآيات ليسجننه حتى حين﴾: ثم is a conjunction; بدا is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is implied, indicated by ﴿ليسجننه﴾, i.e. "it seemed good to them that they imprison him"; ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بدا﴾; ﴿من بعد﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ما is maṣdariyya, and together with what falls within its scope it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿رأوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and الآيات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ليسجننه﴾: the lām is the response to an omitted oath, on the supposition of a saying that is accusative as a ḥāl, i.e. "it appeared to them, after they had seen the signs, saying: By Allah, we will surely imprison him"; so the oath clause and what follows it is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); يسجننه is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the dropped wāw is the fāʿil; the doubled nūn is the heavy nūn of emphasis; and the hā' is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative; حتى is a preposition, and ﴿حين﴾ is genitive by ﴿حتى﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿يسجننه﴾.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿ودخل معه السجن فتيان﴾: the wāw conjoins to something omitted; دخل is a verb; ﴿معه﴾ is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دخل﴾; السجن is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); and فتيان is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿قال أحدهما إني أراني أعصر خمرا﴾: قال is a verb, and أحدهما is the fāʿil; the clause is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yā' is its noun, and the clause أراني is its khabar (predicate); the yā' is the first object of أراني, and the clause أعصر خمرًا is in the position of the second object; and the clause ﴿إني أراني﴾ is the object of a saying (maqūl qawl).
﴿وقال الآخر إني أراني أحمل فوق رأسي خبزا تأكل الطير منه﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; قال الآخر is a verb and its fāʿil; إن is an abrogating particle, the yā' is its noun, and the clause أراني is its khabar; the clause أحمل is the second object of أراني; فوق رأسي is an adverb attached to ﴿أحمل﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of ﴿خبزًا﴾, because it was originally an adjective of it; خبزًا is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause تأكل الطير منه is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خبزًا﴾.
﴿نبئنا بتأويله﴾: an imperative verb, نا being its object and its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); and بتأويله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نبئنا﴾.
﴿إنا نراك من المحسنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause نراك is its khabar; and ﴿من المحسنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نراك﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿قال لا يأتيكما طعام ترزقانه إلا نبأتكما بتأويله قبل أن يأتيكما ذلكما مما علمني ربي﴾: لا is negating; ﴿يأتيكما طعام﴾ is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ترزقانه﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa) of طعام; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿نبأتكما﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; أن together with what falls within its scope is a maṣdar (verbal noun), genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; and the clause إلا نبأتكما is a naʿt (adjective) of طعام, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) of it. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ذلكما مما علمني ربي.]
﴿إني تركت ملة قوم لا يؤمنون بالله وهم بالآخرة هم كافرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yā' is its noun, and the clause تركت is its khabar (predicate); ملة قوم is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون﴾ is an adjective of قوم; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمنون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); بالآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كافرون﴾; ﴿هم﴾ is a tawkīd (emphasis) of ﴿هم﴾; كافرون is the khabar of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿إني تركت﴾ is resumptive or causal (taʿlīliyya), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿واتبعت ملة آبائي إبراهيم وإسحاق ويعقوب﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اتبعت is conjoined to تركت, and the tā' is its fāʿil (agent); ملة آبائي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); إبراهيم is a badal (substitute) of آبائي; and إسحاق and يعقوب are conjoined to إبراهيم.
﴿ما كان لنا أن نشرك بالله من شيء﴾: ما is negating; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb; ﴿لنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate) placed first; إن together with what falls within its scope is its noun placed first [Translator's note: so in the source, «وإن وما في حيزها اسمها المقدم»; presumably أن ... «اسمها المؤخر», "its noun placed after", is meant.]; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نشرك﴾; من is a redundant (ṣila) particle; and شيء is genitive in form, a mafʿūl bihi, accusative in position.
﴿ذلك من فضل علينا وعلى الناس﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿من فضل الله﴾ is the khabar; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فضل﴾; and ﴿على الناس﴾ is conjoined to ﴿علينا﴾. [Translator's note: the verse heading in the source omits الله, while the parsing cites ﴿من فضل الله﴾.]
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يشكرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أكثر الناس is its noun; and the clause لا يشكرون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿يا صاحبي السجن أأرباب متفرقون خير أم الله الواحد القهار﴾: يا is a vocative particle; صاحبي السجن is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), the sign of its accusative being the yā'; السجن is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أأرباب﴾: the hamza is for interrogation seeking affirmation (taqrīr); أرباب is the mubtadaʾ (subject); متفرقون is an adjective (ṣifa); ﴿خير﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿أم﴾ is a conjunction, here connected (muttaṣila); ﴿الله﴾ is conjoined to أرباب; الواحد is an adjective, and القهار a second adjective.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿ما تعبدون من دونه إلا أسماء سميتموها أنتم وآباؤكم﴾: ما is negating; تعبدون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من دونه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); أسماء is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause سميتموهما is an adjective (ṣifa) [Translator's note: so in the source, «سميتموهما»; the verse has سميتموها.]; the tā' is the fāʿil; أنتم is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the tā'; and آباؤكم is conjoined to the tā'.
﴿ما أنزل الله بها من سلطان﴾: ما is negating; أنزل الله is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿بها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنزل﴾; من is a redundant (ṣila) particle; سلطان is genitive in form, a mafʿūl bihi, accusative in position; and the clause is a naʿt (adjective) or a ḥāl.
﴿إن الحكم إلا لله أمر ألا تعبدوا إلا إياه﴾: إن is negating; الحكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of الحكم; the clause ﴿أمر...﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position; أن is maṣdariyya; لا is negating; تعبدوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition with its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أمر﴾, i.e. "He commanded you that you not worship"; إلا is a particle of restriction; and إياه is the object of تعبدوا.
﴿ذلك الدين القيم﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ; الدين is the khabar; and القيم is an adjective.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause after it is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl; لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); أكثر الناس is its noun; and the clause لا يعلمون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿يا صاحبي السجن أما أحدكما فيسقي ربه خمرا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; صاحبي السجن is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), the sign of its accusative being the yā'; السجن is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿أما﴾ is a particle of condition and detailing; أحدكما is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the fā' is linking (rābiṭa); the clause ﴿يسقي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of أحدكما; ربه is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and خمرًا the second.
﴿وأما الآخر فيصلب فتأكل الطير من رأسه﴾: ﴿وأما الآخر﴾ is conjoined to the first ﴿أما﴾; الآخر is the mubtadaʾ; the fā' is linking; the clause يصلب is the khabar; ﴿فتأكل الطير﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, تأكل is conjoined to يصلب, and الطير is the fāʿil (agent) of تأكل; and من رأسه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تأكل﴾.
﴿قضي الأمر الذي فيه تستفتيان﴾: قضي الأمر: [قضي is] a past verb in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named), and الأمر is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); الذي is an adjective (ṣifa) of الأمر; and ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تستفتيان﴾.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿وقال للذي ظن أنه ناج منهما اذكرني عند ربك﴾: ﴿وقال﴾ is conjoined to what precedes it, and its fāʿil (agent) is Joseph; ﴿للذي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause ﴿ظن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position, and the fāʿil of ﴿ظن﴾ is also Joseph; أن together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ظن; أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hā' is its noun, and ﴿ناج﴾ its khabar (predicate); ﴿منهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "the one saved being one of the two", namely the cupbearer; the clause اذكرني is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and ﴿عند ربك﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿فأنساه الشيطان ذكر ربه فلبث في السجن بضع سنين﴾: ﴿فأنساه الشيطان﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; أنساه is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the pronoun referring to the cupbearer; الشيطان is the fāʿil; ذكر is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿فلبث﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, and لبث is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil; ﴿في السجن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl; and بضع سنين is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to ﴿لبث﴾.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿وقال الملك إني أرى سبع بقرات سمان يأكلهن سبع عجاف﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yā' is its noun, and the clause أرى is its khabar (predicate); سبع بقرات is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); سمان is an adjective (ṣifa) of بقرات; ﴿يأكلهن سبع﴾ is an imperfect verb, a mafʿūl bihi and a fāʿil (agent); عجاف is an adjective of سبع; and the clause يأكلهن is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) or an adjective of ﴿بقرات﴾.
﴿وسبع سنبلات خضر وأخر يابسات﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; سبع is conjoined to the first سبع; سنبلات is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); خضر is an adjective of سنبلات; ﴿أخر﴾ is conjoined to سبع; and يابسات is an adjective of ﴿أخر﴾.
﴿يا أيها الملأ أفتوني في رؤياي إن كنتم للرؤيا تعبرون﴾: أفتوني is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the yā' the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿في رؤياي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفتوني﴾; إن is conditional; ﴿كنتم﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the tā' is its noun, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause تعبرون is the khabar of كنتم; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then advise me about my vision"; His saying ﴿للرؤيا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, or it is the khabar of كنتم, and the clause تعبرون is a second khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿قالوا أضغاث أحلام وما نحن بتأويل الأحلام بعالمين﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أضغاث أحلام is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "these are confused dreams", and the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿وما﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿نحن﴾ is the noun of mā; ﴿بتأويل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عالمين﴾; ﴿الأحلام﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿بعالمين﴾: the bā' is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿عالمين﴾ is genitive (majrūr) in form because of the bā' and accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of ﴿ما﴾, which operates like laysa.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وقال الذي نجا منهما وادكر بعد أمة﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿قال الذي﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause نجا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿منهما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ادكر is conjoined to نجا; ﴿بعد أمة﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to ﴿ادكر﴾; or the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause ﴿ادكر﴾ is a ḥāl of the relative noun, or of its returning pronoun, i.e. the fāʿil of نجا.
﴿أنا أنبئكم بتأويله فأرسلون﴾: أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause أنبئكم is the khabar (predicate), and the kāf is its object; ﴿بتأويله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أنبئكم﴾; ﴿فأرسلون﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa), and أرسلوني is a verb and command [Translator's note: so in the source, «فعل وأمر»; «فعل أمر», "an imperative verb", is evidently meant], its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), i.e. "if you want the dream interpreted, then send me".

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿يوسف أيها الصديق أفتنا في سبع بقرات سمان يأكلهن سبع عجاف وسبع سنبلات خضر وأخر يابسات﴾: يوسف is a munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted; ﴿أيها﴾ is accusative in position by specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), because it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma [Translator's note: so in the source; أيها here is ordinarily parsed as a munādā]; الصديق is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾, or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it, following its form; ﴿أفتنا﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and نا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في سبع﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أفتنا﴾; بقرات is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause يأكلهن سبع عجاف is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) or an adjective of ﴿بقرات﴾; and what follows is conjoined to it.
﴿لعلي أرجع إلى الناس لعلهم يعلمون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yā' is its noun, and the clause أرجع is its khabar (predicate); ﴿إلى الناس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أرجع﴾; and ﴿لعلهم يعلمون﴾ is like it.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿قال تزرعون سبع سنين دأبا﴾: the clause تزرعون is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); سبع سنين is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تزرعون﴾; دأبًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of those commanded, i.e. "persevering", or the maṣdar (verbal noun) of an omitted verb, i.e. "you will persevere with perseverance".
﴿فما حصدتم فذروه في سنبله إلا قليلا مما تأكلون﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is conditional or relative, and in either case it is in the position of the accusative as an object placed first, of ﴿حصدتم﴾; حصدتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿فذروه﴾: the fā' occurs in the response to the condition, or [in the predicate of] the relative noun, because of the conditional flavour in it; ذروه is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿في سنبله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ذروه﴾; إلا is a particle of exception; قليلًا is an excepted noun that must be accusative; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿قليلًا﴾; and the clause تأكلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿ثم يأتي من بعد ذلك سبع شداد﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; ﴿يأتي﴾ is an imperfect verb; ﴿من بعد ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); سبع is the fāʿil (agent) of يأتي; and شداد is an adjective (ṣifa) of سبع.
﴿يأكلن ما قدمتم لهن إلا قليلا مما تحصنون﴾: the clause يأكلن is a second adjective of سبع, and the nūn is the fāʿil; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause قدمتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿قدمتم﴾; ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception; ﴿قليلًا﴾ is the excepted; ﴿مما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of ﴿قليلًا﴾; and the clause تحصنون is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿ثم يأتي من بعد ذلك عام فيه يغاث الناس وفيه يعصرون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; the clause ﴿فيه يغاث الناس﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عام﴾; and يعصرون is conjoined to ﴿يغاث﴾, i.e. "they will press grapes and other things".

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وقال الملك ائتوني به فلما جاءه الرسول﴾: conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "when the messenger came to him and told him its interpretation, the king said"; the clause ﴿ائتوني به﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿فلما﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, and لما is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); جاءه الرسول is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first, and a fāʿil (agent).
﴿قال ارجع إلى ربك فاسأله ما بال النسوة اللاتي قطعن أيديهن﴾: ارجع is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿إلى ربك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ارجع﴾; ﴿فاسأله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ارجع﴾, and the hā' is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿بال﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿اسأله﴾, which is suspended from operating (muʿallaqa) by the interrogative; النسوة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); اللاتي is a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa); and the clause قطعن أيديهن is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿إن ربي بكيدهن عليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ربي is its noun; ﴿بكيدهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿عليم﴾; and عليم is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿قال ما خطبكن إذ راودتن يوسف عن نفسه﴾: ما is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and خطبكن is the khabar (predicate); إذ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خطبكن﴾; the clause ﴿راودتن﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; ﴿راودتن﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); يوسف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿عن نفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿راودتن﴾.
﴿قلن﴾: a past verb, and the pronoun is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil.
﴿حاش﴾: a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "declaring Allah far above [all imperfection]".
﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun attached to something omitted, its implied form being "I mean" (أعني).
