﴿ما علمنا عليه من سوء﴾: ﴿ما﴾ is negating; ﴿علمنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿علمنا﴾; ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) particle; and سوء is genitive in form by من and accusative in position as the object of علمنا.
﴿قالت امرأت العزيز الآن حصحص الحق﴾: ﴿قالت امرأة العزيز﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿الآن﴾ is an adverb of time attached to حصحص; and الحق is the fāʿil of حصحص.
﴿أنا راودته عن نفسه﴾: أنا is the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿راودته﴾ — a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi — is in the position of the nominative as the khabar; and ﴿عن نفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿راودته﴾.
﴿وإنه لمن الصادقين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ﴿من الصادقين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of إنه.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿ذلك ليعلم أني لم أخنه بالغيب وأن الله لا يهدي كيد الخائنين﴾: ذلك is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿ليعلم﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and يعلم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the causal lām, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); or ﴿ذلك﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "so the matter is that"; أن and what follows it are to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) standing in place of the two objects of يعلم; the clause ﴿لم أخنه﴾ is the khabar of أني; ﴿بالغيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) or of the object, or it is an adverb, i.e. "in the place of absence", and so it is attached to ﴿أخنه﴾; ﴿وأن الله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أني﴾; the clause يهدي is the khabar of أن; and كيد الخائنين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿وما أبرئ نفسي إن النفس لأمارة بالسوء إلا ما رحم ربي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; ما is negating; أبرئ نفسي is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وإن النفس﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and النفس is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); أمارة بالسوء is its khabar (predicate); إلا is a particle of exception; ما is maṣdariyya, and its position is the accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), the implied form being: "the soul surely commands evil, except for the duration of my Lord's mercy"; or ﴿ما﴾ has the meaning of مَن ("whoever"), the implied form being: "the soul surely commands evil, except for one on whom my Lord has mercy", or: "except a soul on which my Lord has mercy, for it does not command evil".
﴿إن ربي غفور رحيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle; ربي is its noun; and غفور رحيم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿وقال الملك ائتوني به أستخلصه لنفسي﴾: conjoined to what preceded; قال الملك is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ائتوني به is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); and أستخلصه is a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, because it occurs as the response to the command.
﴿فلما كلمه﴾: the fā' conjoins to something omitted; لما is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿كلمه﴾ is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿قال إنك اليوم لدينا مكين أمين﴾: the clause ﴿قال﴾ is the response of ﴿لما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; اليوم is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); لدينا is an adverb of place attached to ﴿مكين﴾; مكين is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and أمين is a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿قال اجعلني على خزائن الأرض﴾: اجعلني is an imperative verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the yā' is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿على خزائن الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second object whose implied form is "in charge" (قيمًا), i.e. "in charge of the storehouses of the land".
﴿إني حفيظ عليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the yā' is its noun, حفيظ is its khabar (predicate), and عليم its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿وكذلك مكنا ليوسف في الأرض يتبوأ منها حيث يشاء﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "and with an establishing like that evident establishing We established"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿مكنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكنا﴾; the object of مكنا is omitted, i.e. "matters"; ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause ﴿يتبوأ﴾ is a ḥāl of يوسف; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يتبوأ﴾; حيث is an adverb (ẓarf) of ﴿يتبوأ﴾, or its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿ما يشاء﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it. [Translator's note: so in the source, «﴿ما يشاء﴾»; the verse has only يشاء.]
﴿نصيب برحمتنا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; نصيب is a nominative imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); and برحمتنا is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نصيب﴾.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿نشاء﴾: a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause formed from them is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا نضيع﴾: conjoined to نصيب.
﴿أجر المحسنين﴾: the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿ولأجر الآخرة خير للذين آمنوا وكانوا يتقون﴾: the lām is the lām of inception (ibtidāʾ); أجر is the mubtadaʾ (subject); الآخرة is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); خير is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أجر﴾; ﴿للذين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خير﴾; the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, a clause with no grammatical position; ﴿وكانوا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; and the clause ﴿يتقون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وجاء إخوة يوسف فدخلوا عليه﴾: the speech is conjoined to earlier speech understood from the context of the story; جاء إخوة يوسف is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿فدخلوا عليه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿جاء إخوة يوسف﴾.
﴿فعرفهم وهم له منكرون﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; عرفهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is circumstantial; ﴿هم﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منكرون﴾; and منكرون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿ولما جهزهم بجهازهم قال ائتوني بأخ لكم من أبيكم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, the speech being conjoined to something implied that is understood from the context of the dialogue; ﴿لما﴾ is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); جهزهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بجهازهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جهزهم﴾; ﴿وقال﴾ is a clause with no grammatical position, because it is the response of لما; ﴿ائتوني﴾ is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause ﴿ائتوني﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿بأخ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to it; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أخ﴾; and ﴿من أبيكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second adjective.
﴿ألا ترون أني أوفي الكيل﴾: the hamza is interrogative; لا is negating; ترون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of ترون; and the clause أوفي الكيل is the khabar (predicate) of إن. [Translator's note: so in the source, «خبر إن»; the particle in the verse is أنّ.]
﴿وأنا خير المنزلين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and خير المنزلين is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فإن لم تأتوني به فلا كيل لكم عندي ولا تقربون﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; إن is conditional; لم is a particle of negation, shifting (to the past) and the jussive; تأتوني is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by لم; the fā' is linking (rābiṭa); لا is the lā of generic negation; كيل is its noun; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿عندي﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; تقربون is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; this [remaining] nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the yā' of the first person has been dropped for lightness, the dropped yā' of the first person being the object of تقربون. Or ﴿لا﴾ is negating, and تقربون is an imperfect verb, jussive by conjunction to the position of His saying ﴿فلا كيل لكم﴾, which is jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), as though it were said: "if you do not bring him to me, you will be deprived and will not come near".

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿قالوا سنراود عنه أباه وإنا لفاعلون﴾: the clause سنراود is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); ﴿عنه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نراود﴾; أباه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وإنا﴾ is a conjoining of clauses; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and فاعلون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿وقال لفتيانه اجعلوا بضاعتهم في رحالهم﴾: ﴿لفتيانه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾; the clause اجعلوا is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); بضاعتهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿في رحالهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted second object.
﴿لعلهم يعرفونها إذا انقلبوا إلى أهلهم﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; the clause يعرفونها is the khabar (predicate) of لعل; إذا is an adverb of future time, and it is muḍāf (annexed); the clause انقلبوا is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the response is omitted, i.e. "then perhaps they will return"; and ﴿إلى أهلهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿انقلبوا﴾.
﴿لعلهم يرجعون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle, the hā' is its noun, and the clause يرجعون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿فلما رجعوا إلى أبيهم قالوا يا أبانا منع منا الكيل﴾: the fā' is a conjunction; لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); رجعوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى أبيهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رجعوا﴾; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position; ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle, and ﴿أبانا﴾ is an annexed munādā (the one addressed); ﴿منع﴾ is a past verb in the passive form (built for that whose agent is not named); ﴿منا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿منع﴾; and الكيل is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿فأرسل معنا أخانا نكتل وإنا له لحافظون﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); أرسل is an imperative verb; ﴿معنا﴾ is an adverb attached to ﴿أرسل﴾; أخانا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿نكتل﴾ is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in response to the request; ﴿وإنا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿حافظون﴾; the lām is the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa); حافظون is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ﴿نكتل﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t:
﴿قال هل آمنكم عليه إلا كما أمنتكم على أخيه من قبل﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position, and it is the answer to an implied question; ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle; آمنكم is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and an object; ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنكم﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿كما أمنتكم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "except with a trusting like my trusting you", i.e. "except with an entrusting like my entrusting you with his brother"; ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya; ﴿أمنتكم﴾ is a past verb, the tā' is the fāʿil, the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is the sign of the plural; the clause ﴿أمنتكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿على أخيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أمنتكم﴾; and ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "before this time".
﴿فالله خير حافظا﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿خير﴾ the khabar (predicate), and حافظًا a tamyīz (specification) or a ḥāl.
﴿وهو أرحم الراحمين﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and أرحم الراحمين the khabar.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿ولما فتحوا متاعهم وجدوا بضاعتهم ردت إليهم﴾: لما is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿فتحوا متاعهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿وجدوا بضاعتهم﴾ is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ردت إليهم is in the position of the accusative as the second object of وجدوا.
﴿قالوا يا أبانا ما نبغي﴾: ﴿قالوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿يا أبانا﴾ is an annexed munādā (the one addressed); ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of the accusative as an object placed first, of ﴿نبغي﴾, i.e. "what more honour do we seek and ask for? Here is our money returned to us"; or ﴿ما﴾ is negating, i.e. "nothing remains for us to ask for".
﴿هذه بضاعتنا ردت إلينا﴾: هذه is the mubtadaʾ (subject), بضاعتنا is the khabar (predicate), and the clause ﴿ردت إلينا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿بضاعتنا﴾ is a badal (substitute) of ﴿هذه﴾ and the clause ﴿ردت إلينا﴾ is the khabar; and the sentence is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك كيل يسير﴾: ﴿ذلك﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, ﴿كيل﴾ the khabar, and ﴿يسير﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿قال لن أرسله معكم حتى تؤتون موثقا من الله﴾: لن is a particle of negation, the accusative and futurity; أرسله is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and an object; ﴿معكم﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسله﴾; حتى is a particle of limit and a preposition; تؤتوني is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied ﴿أن﴾, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yā' of the first person is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and موثقًا is the second mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أرسله; and ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿موثقا﴾.
﴿لتأتنني به إلا أن يحاط بكم﴾: the lām occurs in the response to the oath indicated by His saying ﴿موثقًا﴾; ﴿تأتنني﴾ is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw of the plural, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil; the yā' is the mafʿūl bihi; the doubled nūn is for emphasis; and the third nūn is the nūn of protection; إلا is a particle of exception; and أن together with what falls within its scope is an emptied exception (istithnāʾ mufarragh) from the most general of states, i.e. "you will surely bring him to me in every state except the state of your being encompassed".
﴿فلما آتوه موثقهم قال الله على ما نقول وكيل﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; ﴿لما﴾ is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); آتوه is a verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and موثقهم is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿على ما نقول﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿وكيل﴾; ﴿وكيل﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿الله﴾; and the clause ﴿الله على ما ...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿وقال يا بني لا تدخلوا من باب واحد﴾: يا is a vocative particle; بني is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), the sign of its accusative being the yā', because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; لا is prohibitive; تدخلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; ﴿من باب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدخلوا﴾; and ﴿واحد﴾ is an adjective (ṣifa).
﴿وادخلوا من أبواب متفرقة وما أغني عنكم من الله من شيء﴾: ﴿ادخلوا﴾ is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿من أبواب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ادخلوا﴾; ﴿متفرقة﴾ is an adjective; ﴿ما أغني﴾: ما is negating, and أغني is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); ﴿عنكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أغني﴾; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; and ﴿شيء﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إن الحكم إلا لله عليه توكلت وعليه فليتوكل المتوكلون﴾: إن is negating; الحكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿لله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿توكلت﴾; ﴿وعليه﴾ is the conjoining of a clause to a clause; ﴿فليتوكل﴾: the lām is the lām of command, يتوكل is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command, and المتوكلون is the fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t:
﴿ولما دخلوا من حيث أمرهم أبوهم﴾: ﴿لما﴾ is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); ﴿من﴾ is a preposition, and ﴿حيث﴾ is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive by ﴿من﴾; ﴿من حيث﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دخلوا﴾, the meaning being: "separately"; and the clause ﴿أمرهم أبوهم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿ما كان يغني عنهم من الله من شيء﴾: ما is negating; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to their separating; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يغني﴾; ﴿من الله﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition; شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the response of لما is omitted, indicated by the sense of the negated clause, its implied form being: "there befell them what befell them".
﴿إلا حاجة في نفس يعقوب قضاها﴾: a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) in the sense of: "but a need in the soul of Jacob which he fulfilled"; ﴿في نفس﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa); يعقوب is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause قضاها is an adjective of ﴿حاجة﴾.
﴿وإنه لذو علم لما علمناه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ذو علم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; and the clause علمناه is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ولكن أكثر الناس لا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لكن is an abrogating particle; أكثر الناس is its noun; and the clause لا يعلمون is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿ولما دخلوا على يوسف آوى إليه أخاه﴾: لما is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); من is a preposition [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no من in this phrase]; أخاه is the object of ﴿آوى﴾; and the clause is the response of ﴿لما﴾.
﴿قال إني أنا أخوك فلا تبتئس بما كانوا يعملون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the yā' is its noun; ﴿أنا﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and أخوك the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of إن; the clause ﴿قال...﴾ is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), a clause with no grammatical position; the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); لا is prohibitive; تبتئس is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تبتئس﴾; كانوا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and the clause يعملون is the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t:
﴿فلما جهزهم بجهازهم جعل السقاية في رحل أخيه﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; لما is temporal or linking (rābiṭa); جهزهم is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿بجهازهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جهزهم﴾; the clause ﴿جعل السقاية في رحل أخيه﴾ has no grammatical position; and ﴿في رحل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿ثم أذن مؤذن أيتها العير﴾: ثم is a conjunction of sequence with delay; ﴿أذن مؤذن﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, i.e. "a caller called out"; أيتها is a munādā (the one addressed) from which the vocative particle has been omitted, and it is an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ها is for alerting (tanbīh); and العير is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أية﴾.
﴿إنكم لسارقون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and سارقون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿قالوا وأقبلوا عليهم ماذا تفقدون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, with قد implied; ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقبلوا﴾; ﴿ماذا﴾ is an interrogative noun, an object placed first, of ﴿تفقدون﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun and ﴿ذا﴾ a relative noun that is the khabar (predicate), the clause تفقدون being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿قالوا نفقد صواع الملك﴾: the clause ﴿نفقد صواع الملك﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿ولمن جاء به حمل بعير﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لمن is a khabar (predicate) placed first; the clause ﴿جاء به﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; and حمل بعير is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after.
﴿وأنا به زعيم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أنا is the mubtadaʾ; ﴿به﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زعيم﴾; and زعيم is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿قالوا تالله لقد علمتم ما جئنا لنفسد في الأرض وما كنا سارقين﴾: the tā' is a preposition and particle of oath; ﴿الله﴾, the Name of Majesty, is genitive by the tā' of oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being "we swear"; the lām occurs in the response to the oath, or it is an emphasis of the first oath; ﴿قد﴾ is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); علمتم is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is negating; جئنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لنفسد﴾: the lām is causal (taʿlīl), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "we" (نحن); ﴿في الأرض﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نفسد﴾; ﴿وما كنا﴾: ما is negating, ﴿كنا﴾ is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and سارقين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿قالوا فما جزاؤه إن كنتم كاذبين﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); ما is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject); جزاؤه is the khabar (predicate), the pronoun referring to the cup (al-ṣuwāʿ), i.e. "what is the penalty for stealing it?", or the pronoun refers to the thief; إن is conditional; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); كاذبين is the khabar of كان; and the apodosis of إن is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then what is the penalty for stealing the cup", or [for] the thief.

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿قالوا جزاؤه من وجد في رحله فهو جزاؤه﴾: جزاؤه is the mubtadaʾ (subject); من is conditional, or relative, a second mubtadaʾ; the clause وجد is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, a clause with no grammatical position, or the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); ﴿في رحله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وجد﴾; the fā' is linking (rābiṭa) on both analyses; ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and جزاؤه the khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿فهو جزاؤه﴾ is the khabar of ﴿مَن﴾, and ﴿مَن﴾ with what falls within its scope is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ; on this parsing the pronoun refers to the thief. Or ﴿جزاؤه﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, the hā' referring to the stolen object, and ﴿من وجد في رحله﴾ is its khabar, مَن having the meaning of الذي ("the one who"), the implied form being: "and the penalty for the cup is the one in whose saddlebag it is found". Or ﴿جزاؤه﴾ is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the thing asked about is its penalty", i.e. "enslaving him is its penalty"; and that was the law of the family of Jacob.
﴿كذلك نجزي الظالمين﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a recompense like that We recompense"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿نجزي﴾ is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن); and ﴿الظالمين﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:76-76.t:
﴿فبدأ بأوعيتهم قبل وعاء أخيه ثم استخرجها من وعاء أخيه﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; بدأ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); بأوعيتهم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بدأ﴾; ﴿قبل﴾ is an adverb of time attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); وعاء أخيه is muḍāf and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿ثم﴾ is a conjunction; استخرجها is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), ﴿ها﴾ referring to the cup (al-ṣuwāʿ); and ﴿من وعاء أخيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿استخرجها﴾.
﴿كذلك كدنا ليوسف﴾: ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (mithl), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: "with a contrivance like that contrivance We contrived"; ذلك: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; and ﴿ليوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿كدنا﴾.
﴿ما كان ليأخذ أخاه في دين الملك﴾: ما is negating; كان is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), its noun latent; the lām is the lām of denial (juḥūd); يأخذ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial; the lām and its genitive are attached to something omitted in the position of the khabar (predicate); أخاه is the mafʿūl bihi; and ﴿في دين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأخذ﴾.
﴿إلا أن يشاء الله﴾: the exception is disconnected (munqaṭiʿ), or connected (muttaṣil), from the most general of states, i.e. "except in the state of His willing and permitting that"; the clause ﴿ما كان ليأخذ أخاه...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), and it has been said explicative (tafsīriyya); in either case it has no grammatical position.
﴿نرفع درجات من نشاء﴾: درجات is accusative as an adverb (ẓarf); ﴿مَن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿نشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وفوق كل ذي علم عليم﴾: ﴿فوق﴾ is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar placed first; ﴿كل ذي علم﴾: كل is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf, ذي is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf, and علم is muḍāf ilayhi; and عليم is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t:
﴿قالوا إن يسرق فقد سرق أخ له من قبل﴾: إن is conditional; يسرق is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fā' is linking (rābiṭa) because the apodosis is joined with ﴿قد﴾; ﴿سرق أخ﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa); and ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأسرها يوسف في نفسه ولم يبدها لهم﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; أسرها is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿يوسف﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿في نفسه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أسرها﴾; ﴿لم يبدها﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أسرها﴾; and ﴿لهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يبدها﴾.
﴿قال أنتم شر مكانا والله أعلم بما تصفون﴾: أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); شر is the khabar (predicate); مكانًا is a tamyīz (specification); the clause ﴿أنتم شر مكانًا﴾ is a badal (substitute) of the hā' [in أسرها]; or the pronoun refers to the argument, i.e. "Joseph kept secret within himself the argument against them in their accusing him of theft and did not reveal it to them, and said: You are worse in position"; ﴿الله﴾ is the mubtadaʾ and ﴿أعلم﴾ its khabar; ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; and the clause تصفون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:78-78.t:
﴿قالوا يا أيها العزيز إن له أبا شيخا كبيرا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is a munādā (the one addressed) that is an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda); ها is for alerting (tanbīh); العزيز is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate) placed first; ﴿أبا﴾ is its noun placed after; شيخًا is an adjective, and كبيرًا a second adjective.
﴿فخذ أحدنا مكانه﴾: the fā' is the fā' of eloquence (al-faṣīḥa); خذ is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "you" (أنت); أحدنا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and مكانه is an adverb of place attached to ﴿خذ﴾.
﴿إنا نراك من المحسنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause نراك is its khabar; and ﴿من المحسنين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿نراك﴾ as a second object.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t:
﴿قال معاذ الله أن نأخذ إلا من وجدنا متاعنا عنده﴾: معاذ الله is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by an omitted verb, i.e. "we seek refuge in Allah, a seeking of refuge"; ﴿أن نأخذ﴾: أن together with what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نعوذ; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿مَن﴾ is the object of نأخذ; the clause وجدنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; متاعنا is the object of وجدنا; and عنده is an adverb attached to the verb.
﴿إنا إذا لظالمون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿إذًا﴾ is a particle of response and requital; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and ظالمون is the khabar (predicate) of إن.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t:
﴿فلما استيأسوا منه خلصوا نجيا﴾: لما is a temporal adverb ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); استيأسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿منه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿استيأسوا﴾; ﴿خلصوا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil, and the clause ﴿خلصوا﴾ is the response of ﴿لما﴾; and ﴿نجيا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلصوا.
﴿قال كبيرهم ألم تعلموا أن أباكم قد أخذ عليكم موثقا من الله﴾: the hamza is for interrogation seeking affirmation (taqrīr); لم is a particle of negation, shifting (to the past) and the jussive; تعلموا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾; أن together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of تعلموا; أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), أباكم is its noun, and the clause ﴿قد أخذ﴾ is the khabar (predicate); ﴿عليكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أخذ; موثقًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿موثقًا﴾.
﴿ومن قبل ما فرطتم في يوسف﴾: ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar placed first; ﴿قبل﴾ is made indeclinable on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning, i.e. "and before this"; ما is maṣdariyya, and together with what it enters upon it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after, i.e. "and your failing occurred before this"; ﴿في يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿فرطتم﴾. Or ﴿ما﴾ is relative, i.e. "and before this is the grave offence which you committed regarding Joseph", the position of the relative noun likewise being the nominative as a mubtadaʾ. Or ما is redundant (ṣila), so ﴿من قبل﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb, namely ﴿فرطتم﴾, and the wāw in ﴿ومن قبل﴾ is circumstantial, so the meaning is: "do you not know that your father took a solemn pledge from you before Allah, while you had already failed regarding Joseph before?"
﴿فلن أبرح الأرض حتى يأذن لي أبي﴾: the fā' conjoins to something implied, i.e. "I will stay in Egypt and will not leave it"; ﴿لن﴾ is a particle of negation, the accusative and futurity; ﴿أبرح﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿لن﴾, meaning "I leave", so it is complete (tāmma); the fāʿil of أبرح is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); الأرض is the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and a preposition; ﴿يأذن﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أبرح﴾; ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأذن﴾; and أبي is the fāʿil.
﴿أو يحكم الله لي﴾: أو is a conjunction; يحكم is conjoined to ﴿يأذن﴾, or accusative by an implied أن in response to the negation; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil; and ﴿لي﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿وهو خير الحاكمين﴾: ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ, and خير الحاكمين the khabar.

muyesser-irab:81-81.t:
﴿ارجعوا إلى أبيكم فقولوا يا أبانا إن ابنك سرق﴾: ارجعوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿إلى أبيكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ارجعوا﴾; ﴿فقولوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ارجعوا﴾; ﴿يا﴾ is a vocative particle, and ﴿أبانا﴾ is an annexed munādā (the one addressed); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), ابنك is its noun, and the clause سرق is its khabar (predicate).
﴿وما شهدنا إلا بما علمنا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating; ﴿شهدنا﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شهدنا; and the clause علمنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وما كنا للغيب حافظين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿ما﴾ is negating; كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; ﴿للغيب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿حافظين﴾; and حافظين is the khabar of كنا.

muyesser-irab:82-82.t:
﴿واسأل القرية التي كنا فيها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; اسأل is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); القرية is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); التي is an adjective (ṣifa); the clause كنا is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position; كنا is an incomplete (nāqiṣ), abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿والعير التي أقبلنا فيها﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; العير is conjoined to القرية; ﴿التي﴾ is an adjective; the clause ﴿أقبلنا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position; and ﴿فيها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أقبلنا﴾.
﴿وإنا لصادقون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and صادقون is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:83-83.t:
﴿قال بل سولت لكم أنفسكم أمرا﴾: قال is consequent upon something omitted, i.e. "so they returned, and he said"; ﴿بل﴾ is a particle of digression (iḍrāb); سولت is a past verb, the tā' being for the feminine; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سولت﴾; أنفسكم is the fāʿil (agent); and أمرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فصبر جميل عسى الله أن يأتيني بهم جميعا﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; ﴿صبر﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "my patience"; جميل is a naʿt (adjective); عسى is one of the verbs of hope (rajāʾ); ﴿الله﴾ is its noun; أن together with what falls within its scope is its khabar; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿يأتيني﴾; and جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إنه هو العليم الحكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the hā' is its noun; ﴿هو﴾ is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and ﴿العليم الحكيم﴾ are two khabars of ﴿إن﴾; or ﴿هو﴾ is a mubtadaʾ, ﴿العليم الحكيم﴾ are two khabars of ﴿هو﴾, and the clause is the khabar of إن.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t:
﴿وتولى عنهم وقال يا أسفى على يوسف﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿تولى﴾ is a past verb, i.e. "he turned away from them"; ﴿عنهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تولى﴾; ﴿قال﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تولى﴾; يا is a vocative particle; أسفا is a munādā (the one addressed) annexed to the yā' of the first person, which has been changed into an alif; and ﴿على يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to "sorrow" (al-asaf).
﴿وابيضت عيناه من الحزن فهو كظيم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; ابيضت عيناه is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿من الحزن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ابيضت﴾; ﴿فهو﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and كظيم its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿قالوا تالله تفتأ تذكر يوسف حتى تكون حرضا أو تكون من الهالكين﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the tā' is the tā' of oath, and the Name of Majesty is genitive by the tā' of oath, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath; ﴿تفتأ﴾ is one of the sisters of kāna, its noun latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the clause ﴿تذكر﴾ is its khabar (predicate); يوسف is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit and a preposition; ﴿تكون﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تذكر; حرضًا is the khabar of تكون, and the noun of تكون is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); ﴿أو﴾ is a conjunction; تكون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); and ﴿من الهالكين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to its omitted khabar.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t:
﴿قال إنما أشكو بثي وحزني إلى الله﴾: إنما is the restraining [mā] and the restrained [inna] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); أشكو بثي is an imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); حزني is conjoined to ﴿بثي﴾; and ﴿إلى الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أشكو﴾.
﴿وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; أعلم is conjoined to أشكو; ﴿من الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أعلم﴾; ﴿ما﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause لا تعلمون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿يا بني اذهبوا فتحسسوا من يوسف وأخيه﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿بني﴾ is an annexed munādā (the one addressed), the sign of its accusative being the yā', because it is treated like the sound masculine plural; اذهبوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); the fā' is conjunctive; تحسسوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; ﴿من يوسف﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تحسسوا﴾; and ﴿أخيه﴾ is conjoined to يوسف.
﴿ولا تيأسوا من روح الله﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is prohibitive; ﴿تيأسوا﴾ is jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and ﴿من روح الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تيأسوا﴾.
﴿إنه لا ييأس من روح الله إلا القوم الكافرون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the hā' is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا ييأس﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿من روح الله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿ييأس﴾; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); القوم is the fāʿil; and الكافرون is an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿فلما دخلوا عليه﴾: the fā' is conjunctive; ﴿لما﴾ is temporal ("at the time when") or linking (rābiṭa); دخلوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and ﴿عليه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دخلوا﴾.
﴿قالوا يا أيها العزيز مسنا وأهلنا الضر﴾: the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position; يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is a munādā (the one addressed) that is an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda); ها is for alerting (tanbīh); العزيز is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; ﴿مسنا﴾ is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أهلنا is conjoined to ﴿نا﴾, or is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment); and الضر is the fāʿil.
﴿وجئنا ببضاعة مزجاة فأوف لنا الكيل﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; جئنا is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿ببضاعة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿جئنا﴾; مزجاة is an adjective; ﴿فأوف﴾: the fā' is conjunctive, and أوف is an imperative verb; ﴿لنا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿أوف﴾; and الكيل is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وتصدق علينا إن الله يجزي المتصدقين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; تصدق is conjoined to ﴿فأوف﴾; ﴿علينا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ﴿تصدق﴾; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause يجزي is its khabar (predicate); and المتصدقين is the mafʿūl bihi.
